column3: Imagine that a British marketing firm is doing research in your country. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about exercise.
How often do you exercise, and what kind of exercise do you usually do?
Where do you usually exercise, and do you exercise alone or with other people?
If a new fitness center opened in your neighborhood, which of the following would be most important to you: low prices, modern equipment, or long opening hours? Why?
Hello, I signed up for the marketing workshop next week, but I can't find the schedule. I'd like to ask you a few questions.
Where is the workshop being held, and how much is the registration fee?
I heard Maria Lopez is giving a workshop on social media advertising in the morning. I'm really looking forward to it. That's right, isn't it?
I'm interested in James Wilson's sessions. Could you tell me about all the sessions he's leading?
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? It is better to work for a large company than for a small company. Give specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.

Good morning, and welcome to the Lakeview Art Museum. Today, our special exhibition on modern photography is open on the second floor. Guided tours begin every hour at the information desk, and they last about forty-five minutes. Please remember that food, drinks, and large bags are not allowed in the galleries. Our gift shop and café are located near the main entrance. Enjoy your visit!

Thank you for tuning in to Morning Business News. This week, Brightline Motors announced that its new electric truck will go on sale in March. The vehicle can travel up to five hundred kilometers on a single charge, and it comes in three colors: white, silver, and dark blue. Company officials expect strong demand from delivery services, construction firms, and farmers.
I exercise about three times a week. I usually go running near the river after work, and sometimes I lift weights at the gym on weekends.
I usually exercise at a gym near my office. I mostly work out alone, because I can focus better and go at my own pace.

For me, long opening hours would be the most important. The main reason is that I often work late, so I can't get to the gym until nine or ten p.m. For example, last year my gym closed at nine, and I missed a lot of workouts because of that. If the gym is open late, I can exercise regularly even on busy days. That's why opening hours matter most to me.
The workshop will be held at the Harbor Conference Center on Friday, May fifteenth. The registration fee is seventy-five dollars, and that includes lunch.
I'm sorry, but that workshop has been canceled. However, Maria Lopez is still taking part in the panel discussion on customer service at twelve thirty.

Sure. James Wilson is leading three sessions. First, from nine thirty to ten thirty, he'll give a lecture on building an online store. Second, from one thirty to two thirty, he'll lead a workshop on writing effective emails. Lastly, from two thirty to three thirty, he'll give a lecture on budget-friendly branding. I hope that helps.

I agree that it is better to work for a large company, for two main reasons. First of all, large companies usually offer better salaries and benefits, such as health insurance and paid vacation. This gives employees a stable life. Second, large companies provide more opportunities to learn and grow. For example, my company runs regular training programs, and last year I took an overseas training course that really improved my skills. Of course, small companies can be more flexible, and employees can take on many different roles. However, I think stability and growth opportunities matter more in the long run. For these reasons, I believe working for a large company is a better choice.
